name: io.github.nobleblocks/nobleblocks-mcp
title: NobleBlocks Academic Papers
description: Search 340M+ academic papers from PubMed, arXiv, Crossref, and dozens of other sources — backed by a biomedical knowledge graph with 1.3M+ entities. Ask research questions in plain language, explore citation networks, find related papers, and generate literature reviews instantly.

environmentVariables.name: NOBLEBLOCKS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for Pro tier — higher rate limits and literature review generation. Free tier (100 searches/day) works without a key.
